Every mutation is version"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"ed in a durable ledger and can be rolled back."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### The evolution loop"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Layer | Module | What it does |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| **Observe** | `src/observe` | Listens on `tools/result` and `agent/request-error`; records dedupli"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"cated signals (tool failures, no-progress repeats, request errors) into the durable observations tab"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"le; fires `onTrigger` when a threshold crosses. |
| **Propose** | `src/propose` | A bounded cycle sn"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"apshots the genome + recent observations, calls `ctx.llm.stream()` with a strict prompt, and validat"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"es the model output against a closed mutation vocabulary (`add` / `patch` / `retire` over `skill` / "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"`post-processor` / `prompt-section` / `guard-policy`). Anything that fails parsing or schema validat"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ion is discarded — never applied. Mutations whose content fingerprint already matches a pending `can"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"didate` are dropped, so the same patch is never re-trialed while awaiting validation. |
| **Validate"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"** | `src/validate` | Replays the failing episode inside a fresh scoped sub-agent (`ctx.agents.creat"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"e` + `setup`), once without the candidate mutations (baseline) and once with them (trial), then comp"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"ares metrics: completion, tool failures, tool-call cost. Every kind with a runtime contribution — sk"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"ill, tool-wrapper, guard-policy, post-processor — is exercised via the shared mutation applier (the "},{"id":"p10s13","text":"same code the live apply path uses, so validation == deployment); prompt-section candidates are reco"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"rded but not auto-applied. |
| **Apply** | `src/apply` | Promotes a validated candidate to the live "},{"id":"p10s15","text":"genome: skills are registered on the plugin context via `ctx.skills.register` (immediately visible),"},{"id":"p10s16","text":" the ledger records the apply with the previous content captured, and the disposer is kept for rollb"},{"id":"p10s17","text":"ack. |
| **Rollback** | `src/apply` | Unregisters the live contribution, restores the parent content"},{"id":"p10s18","text":" as a fresh candidate, and writes a `rollback` ledger entry. On plugin disposal every live registrat"},{"id":"p10s19","text":"te, and writes a `rollback` ledger entry. On plugin disposal every live registration is torn down. |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### Safety boundaries"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **The mutation vocabulary is code, the content is model-generated.** The LLM never invents asset k"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"inds or operators; it only fills in payloads that pass the closed zod schema.
- **Validation is by e"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"xecution, not by self-claim.** A proposal is applied only when a sandboxed trial beats the baseline "},{"id":"p12s4","text":"on observable metrics.
- **Cost is capped per cycle and per day.** The budget gate (`maxCostPerCycle"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"` / `dailyBudget`) bounds the proposal call and every trial replay in auto-apply; an exhausted cap p"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"auses the loop instead of silently burning tokens.
- **Rollback is first-class.** Every applied muta"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"tion keeps its disposer and its parent content; regression reverts the exact previous state.
- **Obs"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"erve-only is the default.** In `observe` mode the plugin never proposes — it just collects signals a"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"default.** In `observe` mode the plugin never proposes — it just collects signals and logs triggers."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The plugin is a **dsh bundle**: install it with the official CLI in one command — no manual `cordis."},{"id":"p14s2","text":"yml` editing required."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"`dsh plugin add` initializes the profile if needed, installs the package, and automatically adds `ds"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"h-auto-evolve` to the profile's bundle stack (`dsh.profile.bundles`). The bundled `cordis.patch.yml`"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" registers the plugin row with the defaults below; restart `dsh` and the plugin is live."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Local development / source build:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Custom configuration"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The bundle applies a default config; to change it, override the row in your own profile patch (appli"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ed after every bundle layer):"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> Note: a patch **replaces** the row's whole config rather than merging into it, so specify every fi"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"eld you want to keep. The plugin's peer services (storage, LLM, tools, skills) come from the dsh-bas"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"e/web bundles — no extra setup."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### Modes"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Mode | Behavior |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| `observe` | Collect signals, fire triggers, **never propose**.
